Ticket Id: 28698

Dr M McLaren

Neurologist

Suite 3

37 The Crescent

Newtown

09-08-2014

RE: Mr Micheal Weir                        DOB: 20-09-1970                                                     Commented [ESL1]: spelling
                                                                                                               Commented [ESL2]: ,
I am writing to refer Mr Weir, a 44-year-old patient, whose features are suggestive of multiple sclerosis.

Mr Weir has been suffering from depression for which he has been commenced on Zoloft for 2 years. He is
a smoker and overweight.

On 29-06-2014, Mr Weir presented complaining of tiredness and stress. He reported a feeling of rundown
sensation. On examination, no significant abnormalities were detected. One week later, he returned with
the same complaint in addition to a weakness in his left leg. His laboratory results showed low levels of
haemoglobin, hematocrite, white blood cells and red blood cells. I advised him to modify his lifestyle, quit   Commented [ESL3]: spelling
smoking and perform physical exercise.

On today's review, Mr Weir reported 2 recent attacks of blackouts in addition to dizziness, stress and mood
swings after his last visit. Moreover, he complained of hand tingling, left leg weakness, occasional
constipation and breathlessness. His examination revealed a low blood pressure measurement (88/70), a
diminished left patellar reflex and a loss of sensation in both hand.                                          Commented [ESL4]: hands

In view of the above, I ordered a CT of both the head and the spine. I would be appreciated if you could       Commented [ESL5]: It
perform a full neurological assessment of Mr Weir including an MRI request.

Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
